text:
Owen (partnerships): quick preflight — Datadog wants a short marketplace tile sanity run on our private GPU appliance next Fri. Goal: validate dashboards, trace->log linking, and packaged alert rules. Can we carve 30-45m?
Kara (eng-runtime): yes we can. Need sample app container, OTLP collector config, and a scoped ingest key. Also confirm log correlation uses W3C traceparent header.
Marta (datadog-partner): will drop a dashboard bundle + collector config and a sample workload container. Well include a small log-forwarder snippet to exercise trace->log linking.
Ben (eng-ml): to exercise cache evictions run mixed seq lengths [64,256,512,1024] and include a few long-running spans. Model binary ~9GB; partner will host it.
Sofia (product): success criteria (single line): "Dashboards render within 45s, trace->log links open from span to corresponding log lines, alert rule fires on synthetic 5% error burst, and exporter RSS growth <18% over 30m."
Kara (eng-runtime): plan: 1) quick staging smoke (20m) 2) tune exporter flags (batch_size, linger_ms, max_queue) 3) partner rack run 4) capture dashboard snapshot + perf strip. Who owns press snapshot?
Owen (partnerships): partnerships owns the press-ready snapshot + partner quote. Eng provides perf slices and a 2-line blurb for the tile. Legal needs 24h review.
Marta (datadog-partner): will embargo demo creds and send the bundle and wiring snippet in a follow-up link. Sampling guidance: baseline 1/20, 1/1 for error traces.
Kara (eng-runtime): quick sanity curl for exporter endpoint when staging is up:
```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/x-protobuf' --data-binary @tiny_trace.pbf
# expect 200 and "accepted" in exporter logs
```
ci-bot: build redwood/exporter:v1.6.0 passed all checks — deploy when ready (ci/3487654321).
Ben (eng-ml): test knobs for the run: REDWOOD_MAX_SEQ=1024 REDWOOD_CACHE_TTL=60s and run mixed batch sizes to surface eviction counters.
Owen (partnerships): actions: Marta to drop bundle + collector config by EOD; Kara/Ben to run staging Thurs AM; partner run Fri. Ill loop in comms and legal for embargo/quote signoff.
Sofia (product): add a 3-line customer wiring blurb for tile docs: "Set DD_API_KEY in your collector, enable trace->log correlation (traceparent header), and import the packaged dashboard JSON."
Kara (eng-runtime): will draft the 3-line wiring blurb and post here.
Owen (partnerships): thanks team :thumbsup:
